methodology.runs: Three measured fresh and three measured warm samples per block; one configured warmup; initial path-postings screen used one sample
methodology.order: Serial exploratory blocks, not randomized: discovery, base, eight workers, SQLite paths, SQLite IDs, final transport comparisons, hybrid, confirmation blocks
methodology.cold: Absent application Catalog, OS cache not flushed; first-read outliers retained
methodology.memory: Median of maximum observed whole-scenario RSS, not guaranteed OS peak; Rust short-worker observations can be missing
methodology.node: Long-lived headless benchmark host, not full Workbench or renderer memory
methodology.storage: Logical end-of-scenario cache bytes, including free pages and retained snapshots; not peak disk
methodology.scope: Same maintained showcase refresh, five query routes, header folding, and cold-only input decoding
methodology.limitations: Observed medians and ranges, no causal confidence intervals; repair is a single cached-timestamp mismatch, not an authored source change; no clean Depot timing
